verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own support documentation describes Copilot connectors for OneDrive, Google Drive, Outlook.com and Gmail mail, and Outlook/Google calendars. Once connected, Copilot can find, summarize, and act on that content, with documented examples of file, email, and calendar queries. Connectors are limited to Copilot.com and Copilot Mobile. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the consumer connectors (the community praise refers to Microsoft 365 integration, not these connectors), and documentation of desktop or other surfaces beyond Copilot.com and mobile.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Copilot can connect with the following consumer services: Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft Outlook.com (email, calendar, and contacts), Google Drive, Google Gmail, Calendar, Contacts
Connectors allow you to link Copilot to other services so you can easily find, summarize, and act on information from these services.
Show me emails from Sarah about the budget
Copilot connectors are currently available on Copilot.com and on Copilot Mobile (iOS and Android)
